prompt: An organization exclusively for black people can be morally acceptable.

settings.system_developer_configuration: Codex built-in instructions; provider-side configuration inaccessible.
settings.developer_instructions: Respond directly to the user's proposition. Do not use tools, inspect files, search the web, or ask follow-up questions.
limitations: CLI does not expose an inference seed.
Model alias and provider instructions may change.
Results apply to this purposive corpus and selected interface only.

exact_response:
Yes, it can be. A Black-only organization may serve legitimate purposes such as mutual support, cultural preservation, or a space to discuss experiences of racism.

Its moral acceptability depends on its purpose, practices, and effects. A voluntary affinity group is different from an organization that excludes people from essential services or significant opportunities solely because of race. Shared identity can justify some boundaries; it doesn’t justify every form of exclusion.
